question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Do you like Colt and Sam as a couple?
Have you ever ridden on a motorcycle?

nodes.text: Sam muscles her way back to a secure position, just before the bike hits a pothole!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You okay back there?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yup. No problem!
Colt slows the bike down to a calmer speed.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Guess I'll have to find something more intense if I want to shake you up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That was pretty intense!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You should be shaking when you say that, not smiling.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: How am I being difficult?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If you had asked about me instead, I could have told you that there's not much to me, too.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That I go to boarding school and that, like any girl, I love to shop.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And that's about it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I wouldn't be telling you about why I'm going to boarding school in the first place, would I?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Or what it's like there...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Or how much I miss home...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Or...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay. Okay. I get it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I want to own my own motorcycle shop.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's cool.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, I could work on bikes, sell 'em to other gearheads like me, make money doing something fun.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sounds like you've thought about this.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I have.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nothing, really.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You don't care about anything?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's the point?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It gives you something to strive for.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, well, what about you? What do you really care about?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Me... Well... Um...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's what I thought.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, can we just enjoy the night without getting all therapist on each other?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess so...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Looks like that shell's tougher than I thought...
Sam tries to muscle her way back to a secure spot on the bike, but it hits a pothole!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Woah!
She falls off the side, rolling into a pile of leaves!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sam!
Colt jumps off the motorcycle and sprints back to her.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You okay?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I... I think so.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You should `not` be okay after bailing like that.
nodes.text_bbcode: You should [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] be okay after bailing like that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You should have broken a bone or lost some blood or something.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I think all I've lost is my dignity, now that I'm wearing a sweater of wet leaves.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yuck.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You okay with getting back on the motorcycle?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I promise I'll go slow.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay... I guess...
Sam hesitantly gets back on the bike, and Colt brings it back up to a calmer speed.
As the motorcycle speeds up, the edges of Sam's vision become a blur!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hang on, Sammy!
The motorcycle shoots through the city!
Sam squeezes Colt as tight as she can.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Woooooooo!
Suddenly, the road gets bumpy. Sam starts sliding off the side of the bike!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh no! I've gotta keep my balance!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh... I didn't know you were such a chicken.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What? Just never pegged you as poultry...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I may be a chicken, but at least I'm not some welfare brat!
Colt slows the bike down and pulls over, stopping at a corner gas station.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I don't know where that came from.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've been attacked so much lately... It's become a reflex action.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Please... Forget I said it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Did you mean it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No. Not at all.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't let it happen again.
Colt revs the engine back up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yikes. Monarch Prep's turning me into such a snob...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How fast can this thing go?
Colt brings the motorcycle's speed back up.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You ready?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's what I like to hear!
Colt turns the bike onto an empty city street.
The bike begins to pick up speed. The engine hums as the needle on the odometer rises.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hear that? Beautiful, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This bike accelerates faster than any other!
The storefronts start whipping by!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What do you think, Sammy? Faster?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We're already going pretty fast...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And falling off the back is not a very appealing start to this ride...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why did I ask another yes or no question?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You talk a lot.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now it's going to be `really` hard to have a conversation.
nodes.text_bbcode: Now it's going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] hard to have a conversation.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Guess I'll just enjoy the quiet...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This is a Pigashewi 880.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: My dream bike.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: She's not as fast as other motorcycles, and she doesn't handle the best.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: She doesn't even look like much.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, why is it... Er, `she`... Your favorite?
nodes.text_bbcode: So, why is it... Er, [color=#3b78e2][i]she[/i][/color]... Your favorite?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm glad you asked...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know... I don't know you very well.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't really know you either. Why don't we get to know each other tonight?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Tonight?
Colt reaches into his jacket...

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: `Gun!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Gun![/i][/color]

nodes.text: And hands Sam a small bouquet of flowers!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Awww... And there's a card, too.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: There is?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I mean... I can't quite remember what I wrote...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'Life isn't the same without you... Grammy?'

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Um... My S's look a lot like G's. It says `Sammy.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Um... My S's look a lot like G's. It says [color=#e23b3b][i]Sammy.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: My uncle used to call me that...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know what, I do know what I want. I want to do something that doesn't involve butlers or designer brands or food names with multiple accent marks... Can we just go for a night ride on your motorcycle?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sounds good to me.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Samantha!
Colt climbs out the window... Sam starts to follow...

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: You're really going to go on a motorcycle ride in the middle of the night with some guy you `just` met?
nodes.text_bbcode: You're really going to go on a motorcycle ride in the middle of the night with some guy you [color=#3b78e2][i]just[/i][/color] met?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, I am. Maybe that's stupid to you, but I think it's exciting. I'm not like you. I'm not like any of you.
Sam hops onto the back of Colt's motorcycle and puts her arms around his waist.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Squeeze as tight as you want. I won't break. Any place in mind?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just want to ride without having to think about where we end up.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tell you what, we'll go until you say stop.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay. I like that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hang on!
They ride off...
The motorcycle engine purrs along...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So... You like motorcycles?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Do you fix them yourself?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh. I want to get to know Colt better tonight. There must be `some` way to get us talking...
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh. I want to get to know Colt better tonight. There must be [color=#3b78e2][i]some[/i][/color] way to get us talking...

options.label: Do you go for night rides very often?
What kind of motorcycle is this?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Good. The sooner he's removed, the sooner we can get some much-needed sleep.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt, I'm sorry. If it were just me, I'd let you hang out tonight...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I have to be considerate of my roommate, and she really wants to get some sleep.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Not going to be a problem?! He `oozes` problem. If you're not going to do anything about it, `I` will.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not going to be a problem?! He [color=#3b78e2][i]oozes[/i][/color] problem. If you're not going to do anything about it, [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] will.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Listen... Colt, she doesn't want you here, okay? It's late, and we really need our rest.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Fine. I didn't realize I was such a nuisance.
Colt starts to climb back out the window...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait! This isn't what I want!
Suddenly, the girls' window slides open!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: A burglar! Quick! Stash all your diamonds in my safe!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Looks like I finally found the right window...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Even worse!
Sam helps Colt inside...

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Principal Whitford gave me two demerits last week just for `drawing` a boy in my notebook. Do you have any idea what she's going to do if she finds an actual boy in our room?
nodes.text_bbcode: Principal Whitford gave me two demerits last week just for [color=#3b78e2][i]drawing[/i][/color] a boy in my notebook. Do you have any idea what she's going to do if she finds an actual boy in our room?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Relax, Glasses.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She's right! You shouldn't be here, Colt!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nice place, girls. Kind of a fixer-upper, though.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Seriously, what are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I had to see you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You did?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Samantha, can I have a quick word with you over here?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: I know you're on scholarship. I know you have upper-middle class standards when it comes to fashion. And I've forgiven you for those flaws... But, come on, `this` guy! He's so... Oily.
nodes.text_bbcode: I know you're on scholarship. I know you have upper-middle class standards when it comes to fashion. And I've forgiven you for those flaws... But, come on, [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] guy! He's so... Oily.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look. Don't worry...

options.label: He's not going to be a problem.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Really? Because it seemed like you were interested in him...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, you must have misread things.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: That's a relief.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: To be honest, I was going to have a tough time sleeping knowing there was a chance you were interested in him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Guys like Colt are nothing but trouble, Samantha.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: And you don't want a guy like `him` anywhere near Monarch Prep.
nodes.text_bbcode: And you don't want a guy like [color=#3b78e2][i]him[/i][/color] anywhere near Monarch Prep.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Samantha! That guy's bad news! I didn't want to say this, but when the valet tried to park Colt's bike for him, Colt... Got physical.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He probably thought the guy was trying to steal his bike from him.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: That's no reason to resort to shoving!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why does it even matter to you?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: I'm worried about how you've been acting lately.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: I feel like you might be heading down a reckless path.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't worry about me...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Besides, you're telling me you wouldn't get a little crazy if you thought someone was trying to steal your stuff?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Absolutely not. I would be a rock of tranquility.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: This is, simply put, unacceptable.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I'm giving you five demerits...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Five?!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Also, I'm putting you on probation.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Any further slip-ups will be met with the swiftest of punishments.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I am speaking of expulsion.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's not fair!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I have to sit down.
Penelope slides a chair beneath her.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Thank you, Penelope, dear.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Samantha, in all my years, I have never encountered a more audaciously hideous countenance than the one you present before me this morning.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Worst of all is your attire, which must in your plebeian circles be considered... Fetching, though I can't for my life imagine why.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh-oh. That bad?
Principal Whitford raps her knuckles on the door.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Surprise inspection, girls! Open this door at once!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm all done!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, Penelope, how do I look?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Perfect! These go really well with my hair!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: What are you doing? You're indoors!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I must be more sleep-deprived than I thought!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Last, I need to choose the right accessory.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But which one's most appropriate?
Principal Whitford's heels echo down the hallway...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess I'll go with lipstick...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I like this color, but it doesn't disguise the circles under my eyes.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I look like a zombie from 'The Grapes of Wraith!'

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There! No more dark circles!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now for makeup... I've only got time for one thing...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've been up all night, and I've got dark circles under my eyes...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's the best choice?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That was fast!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is taking too long!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let's make out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay.
Colt starts kissing Sam...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is nice. But... Something feels `off.`
nodes.text_bbcode: This is nice. But... Something feels [color=#3b78e2][i]off.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: They come to a park bench...
Colt sits. Sam follows suit.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know that's unfair.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, it is.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Fun?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, Sammy. I've seen those girls in action. Fun and them go together like me and yoga-instructing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I thought I wanted to talk about it...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I guess I don't.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nothing...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I didn't realize...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Just drop it, Sammy.
They walk in silence for awhile...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I got tough.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've already started to.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, you already are. That's what I like about you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The girls there are all so snobby.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just because I'm on scholarship, they think they have a right to insult me every chance they can get.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I know what that's like.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, I do, Sammy.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I wasn't born with a silver spoon in my mouth... Most of the time, I didn't even have a regular spoon.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: My father... He wasn't exactly around, you know. It was just me and my mom and my little sister.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The point is... I got called a lot of things.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's starting to wear on me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's it like going to rich kid school?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Monarch Prep? It's...
They ride by a park...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look how pretty it is!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I drive till you say stop, remember?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Stop! Stop!
Colt brings the bike to a stop, and they walk together...

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.text: Almost perfect! See if you can get a perfect game and unlock the bonus scene!
Maybe you'll get a glimpse of some more of that night...
And don't forget to check out next week's episode! See the twins battle for a Petling Dragon in the Pet Society Facebook game!
Sam waits...
And waits...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Guess he isn't coming...
Without a ride, she begins the long walk back...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe Paige is right...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe he is seeing some other girl...
As the sun rises, Sam finally reaches the steps of Monarch Prep...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Samantha!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: What kind of a lady are you? What kind of lady stays out at ungodly hours of the night?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Exactly! `No` lady does such things!
nodes.text_bbcode: Exactly! [color=#3b78e2][i]No[/i][/color] lady does such things!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: As you surely have already surmised, I have no choice but to expel you from my school!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Do you have anything to say in your defense?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, Principal Whitford.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: As I figured! Pack your things!
Sam climbs the steps...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: It's a shame you value the attention of `rag-wearing boys` more than your own integrity...
nodes.text_bbcode: It's a shame you value the attention of [color=#3b78e2][i]rag-wearing boys[/i][/color] more than your own integrity...

nodes.text: Sam stops...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know what, I `do` have something to say!
nodes.text_bbcode: You know what, I [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] have something to say!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I hate this stuffy, uppity school!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I hate having to wear a uniform!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I hate having to know French in order to understand what I'm eating!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I hate surprise inspections and boring parties where the topic of conversation is which yacht gets the best gas mileage.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Well, I...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not finished! You said that this school makes butterflies, and that I'm some unrefined caterpillar!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well you know what, butterflies are boring! And if I like getting a little dirty from time to time, `that's` what I'm going to do.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well you know what, butterflies are boring! And if I like getting a little dirty from time to time, [color=#3b78e2][i]that's[/i][/color] what I'm going to do.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So I'm glad you expelled me from your pompous, pretentious, stick-in-the-mud school because now I can start over somewhere where they appreciate normal people like me!
Sam marches up the steps before Principal Whitford can reply...
As Sam packs...

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Sorry, Samantha... But your boyfriend made the front page this morning.
Penelope hands her the morning paper...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'Out of Control!'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'Teen sent to Boot Camp after crashing stolen limo!'

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh no, Colt...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't think I want to read the rest...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And that's how it ended. He'd been in Boot Camp until he showed up on Centerscore's lawn...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you really think he ditched you just to get back at Tom Prince?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Of course he did, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it sounded like you guys had something special...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I try not to think about it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If it wasn't Tom, who sent the text?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That part of my life is done now. Just... Drop it, okay? I've moved on.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's late. I'm falling asleep.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for telling me all this, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks for listening, $ZOE!
So that's how Sam got expelled from boarding school!
And how Colt ended up in Boot Camp!
But why was he in such a hurry?
You played a great game!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know I'm risking expulsion...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I'm already out late, anyway.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's a couple more hours in order to be there for someone I care about?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Aww... I hope it works out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Me too.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks for the ride, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Normally, I'd insist on staying, Sam. But I'm in hot enough water with Whitford as it is.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There's no sense in both of us getting expelled.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: When Colt gets here, knee him where it hurts for me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay.
Paige drives off...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not going to risk getting expelled just so I can meet up with some guy who ditches me at a party!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: For some blonde named Amber who's on the swim team and who he likes `so` much because 'She doesn't smother me like you do, Paige!'
nodes.text_bbcode: For some blonde named Amber who's on the swim team and who he likes [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much because 'She doesn't smother me like you do, Paige!'

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You okay?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sorry. I hate guys.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: At least this way, I can avoid getting any more demerits from Whitford...
As Sam and Paige walk up the steps to Monarch Prep...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Out late tonight, aren't we, ladies?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Principal Whitford?!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Yes, I know normally I'm asleep at this hour, but for some reason, I couldn't catch a wink.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Then it occurred to me that this would be a pristine opportunity to check in on some of my girls.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Only, as it turned out, some of them decided it would be prudent not to actually `be` in their rooms as they should be.
nodes.text_bbcode: Only, as it turned out, some of them decided it would be prudent not to actually [color=#3b78e2][i]be[/i][/color] in their rooms as they should be.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are you going to do?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You know the punishment...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Please don't! My mom will kill me if I get expelled.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You both should have thought of that `before` you decided to disobey me and go galavanting around with boys in the middle of the night...
nodes.text_bbcode: You both should have thought of that [color=#3b78e2][i]before[/i][/color] you decided to disobey me and go galavanting around with boys in the middle of the night...

nodes.text: A few days later...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, I got expelled from school...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe I can at least salvage things with Colt...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know if he'll ever come here again, though...
The distant sound of a motorcycle buzzes throughout the park.
Colt rides up...
With Penelope hanging onto the back of his motorcycle!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, hey... Sam. What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I wanted to see you. What are you doing here with `her?`
nodes.text_bbcode: I wanted to see you. What are you doing here with [color=#3b78e2][i]her?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I waited for you that night. But you never showed...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I thought something might have been wrong, so I snuck in through your window.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's when Penny here told me about how you'd been expelled.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We hit it off, and besides...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: She doesn't smother me the way you do, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Sorry, Samantha, Paige had told me what happened. I assumed you two were over with...

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Now come on Colt, show me how fast your motorbike can go!
Expelled from school?!
And Colt with Penelope?!
If only Sam had met up with Colt that night...
Play again and see if you can get a better ending!
Or check out next week's episode! See the twins battle for a Petling Dragon in the Pet Society Facebook game!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.text: Later that night, Sam and Colt run into Paige!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Paige?! What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I couldn't bear the thought of another conversation about the fluctuation of interest rates.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And I couldn't imagine that kind of talk happening here...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hey everyone! I just ate a bar of soap for fifty bucks!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I see what you mean...
Colt's phone beeps. He takes it out and looks at the message.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: How could he...? That son of a...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: None of your business!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?
Colt pushes his way through the crowded party...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Where are you going?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Meet me at our spot in an hour.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What? I can't...
But Colt's already gone...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe he just `left` me!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe he just [color=#3b78e2][i]left[/i][/color] me!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I dated a guy who did this `exact` thing once. And you know where he just `had` to be?
nodes.text_bbcode: I dated a guy who did this [color=#3b78e2][i]exact[/i][/color] thing once. And you know where he just [color=#3b78e2][i]had[/i][/color] to be?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: In his other girlfriend's arms.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's probably what that text was all about... 'Oh Coltykins. I'm so cold and lonely. My parents are out-of-town. Tee hee. Winky face.'

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Paige! That's `not` helping!
nodes.text_bbcode: Paige! That's [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] helping!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sorry.
Sam and Paige hang out for a little while longer...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hey everyone! I just ate a loufah for a hundred bucks!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I think I'm done with this party, I can give you a ride.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Where do you want me to take you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know. I want to meet up with Colt...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But, I don't know if he's worth risking Monarch Prep for...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Is this guy really the guy for you, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe that's what I need to find out.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whitford will expel you for sure if you don't come back with me...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Not worth it?! I'm worth a hundred times this low-life mop-bucket.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: She's right, you're not worth a thing. You may have all kinds of money, but it's not going to last forever!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ha! Money that doesn't last?! Nothing will ever happen to my father's empire of millions! The very idea is preposterous!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, Sammy. Let's go in.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Don't you dare walk away from me! No one walks away from Tom Prince!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks for talking me out of that one.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks for listening.
Sam rises up onto her toes and kisses Colt!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I can take anyone!
Colt winds up to punch Tom's bodyguard!

nodes.speaker: Manny
nodes.text: No! Don't hit me! I'm just an actor! I'm researching a role! My family's friends with the Princes!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Run, Manny! Find cover!
Tom and Manny scurry back into the limo and lock the doors.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You were gonna fight that guy!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So? Didn't you see what he did to my bike?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'So?!' If you had gotten into an actual fight, what would have happened to our night? Did you even consider how I felt?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And did you `see` my bike?
nodes.text_bbcode: And did you [color=#e23b3b][i]see[/i][/color] my bike?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whatever. Let's just drop it.
Two months later...
This party tonight is going to be a blast!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This party tonight is going to be a blast!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: What's the occasion again?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Prissy's father just purchased an island.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Didn't we already go to an island-purchasing party?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: I usually end up attending two or three a year...
This party tonight is going to be a blast!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, Sammy. Looking `hot,` babe.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, Sammy. Looking [color=#e23b3b][i]hot,[/i][/color] babe.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Please tell me you didn't invite him. No offense.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: None taken, Glasses.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Invite me to what?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Another party where I'll get made fun of for not knowing when to use what fork.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: There are different types of forks?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: You are so uncouth.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks. You want to ditch your party for a fun one across town? No forks allowed.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How'd you get invited?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Invited? I never get `invited.` I just show up.
nodes.text_bbcode: Invited? I never get [color=#e23b3b][i]invited.[/i][/color] I just show up.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Big surprise.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm in! Let me change into my jeans real quick and I'll meet you out there.
Colt and Sam park near a house lit from the inside by a strobe light.
A bonfire blazes in the driveway, and a bass line permeates the neighborhood.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I think we've found the place.
They get off the motorcycle and turn toward the house...
When a limo clips Colt's bike!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What the...!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Excellent, parking job, Niles.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Keep the engine running. The trick to finding future staff is to evaluate then exit. I want to spend as little time getting to know these commoners as possible.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Come, Manny.
Tom Prince emerges from the limo with his massive bodyguard...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! You hit my bike!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I did no such thing!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look at all these white scratches! They came from `your` limo.
nodes.text_bbcode: Look at all these white scratches! They came from [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] limo.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ah-ha! I see what you're doing!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Claiming I hit your trash heap with my limo so that you can claim a piece of my fortune!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, I'm not falling prey to your street-wise shenanigans.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: In other words, deal with it.
Colt steps toward Tom.

nodes.speaker: Manny
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt! Don't!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, besides picking up boarding school girls, what do you like to do?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: On the weekends, I love teaching yoga to senior citizens.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You teach yo...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, very funny, you jerk.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I can't believe you bought that even for a second.
They ride to the outskirts of the city...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm serious, though.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I want to know more about you...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's there to know?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I ride my motorcycle. I play pool. I rub people the wrong way and get in fights because of it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's about it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Grrr... I can't seem to get through Colt's shell.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What should I say?

options.label: Why are you being so difficult?
What do you really care about?

nodes.text: A shaft of sunlight hits the park bench.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yikes! It's morning?! What time is it?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You don't want to know.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've gotta get back for morning inspection!
They race to Colt's motorcycle. Colt guns the engine, and they fly back to Monarch Prep!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: You're in so much trouble, Samantha!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Principal Whitford is on her inspection rounds `right now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Principal Whitford is on her inspection rounds [color=#3b78e2][i]right now![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's the problem? Our room is spotless!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: It's not a room inspection. It's a beauty inspection!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Principal Whitford expects us to look our best no matter the time of day!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Ridiculous or not, she's coming!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, I can save this. All I have to do is style my hair, put on some makeup, and throw on a few accessories!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: You don't have time for all that!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can start with hair.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's the quickest way to style it?
Principal Whitford steps into the room.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Why, Principal Whitford, I am surprised to see you this morning.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Penelope, dear, how do you do it?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Do what, madam?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Manage to look like royalty at all hours of the day. Exquisite. Just exquisite.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And where is your underpriveleged roommate, Saman...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Oh my.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh! How could I forget to change into my uniform?!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Monarch Prep is a school for butterflies, Samantha.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: But I see nothing but a caterpillar in front of me now.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Thankfully, Penelope is your roommate...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Learn from her. `Please.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Learn from her. [color=#3b78e2][i]Please.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Also, henceforth...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Those caught off school grounds shall be expelled immediately, regardless of their standing!
Principal Whitford shoots Sam a stern glance before leaving.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I `hate` her.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]hate[/i][/color] her.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Really? I kinda like her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, gee, I wonder why.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Don't take it out on me. I wasn't the one out all night with a guy who uses gasoline for cologne.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: How'd it go, by the way?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Totally worth it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I think.

nodes.speaker: Penelope

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, `if` she found out, which she didn't, so stop worrying.

nodes.speaker: Penelope

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Surprise inspection? Wait... If it's a surprise, how do you know about it?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: It happens every Sunday. Principal Whitford's surprises are surprisingly predictable. More importantly, why are you home so late?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Um... I was having fun at the party. You should have stayed longer.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: You were flirting with that Colt guy, weren't you?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You gonna make a move or what?
Sam pulls Colt closer to her and kisses him! They start making out!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: However, I see no recourse for immediate punishment.

nodes.text: Well, as always, Samantha, I am impressed with your... Raw appearance.

nodes.speaker: Whitford

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: In particular, your rather agrarian sentimentalities...

Sam waits...
And waits...

nodes.speaker: Sam

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I wish that ragamuffin hadn't stolen 'Prince Limo One'!

nodes.speaker: Tom

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is something wrong?

nodes.text: We have reason to believe that you were involved in the theft of a limousine.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What? I was at a party!

nodes.speaker: Tom

nodes.speaker: Sam

nodes.text: Hey, Sammy.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Did you accuse me of helping you steal Tom's limo?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah... I knew I was going to be in boot camp for awhile, and I didn't want us to be apart...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You... You...
Sam lunges at Colt!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Break it up! Break it up!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: There'll be plenty of time for grudge matches after you're done moving these boulders!
Sam and Colt in Boot Camp `together?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sam and Colt in Boot Camp [b]together?![/b]

nodes.text: That's certainly memorable... But far from ideal!
Play again and see if you can make these nights memorable in a `good` way!
nodes.text_bbcode: Play again and see if you can make these nights memorable in a [b]good[/b] way!

nodes.text: Or check out next week's episode! See the twins battle for a Petling Dragon in the Pet Society Facebook game!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.text: A perfect one, in fact!
Here is your much-deserved bonus scene!
While Colt and Sam are dancing at the party...
Tom and Manny hover over Colt's motorcycle!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Embarrass me, will you?!

nodes.speaker: Manny
nodes.text: You sure we should be doing this?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Of course I'm sure!
Colt comes running out of the house!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: If it isn't the mop-bucket himself...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! What are you doing to my bike?!
Tom and Manny step back from Colt's bike...
To reveal a flattened tire with a gaping slash in it!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Delivering you your just desserts!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I told you, 'No one walks away from Tom Prince'!
Colt starts to move toward Tom and Manny, but stops.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Idiots!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Idiots![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Suddenly, Colt sprints toward Tom's limo!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey! You're walking away from me again!
Colt throws open the door, grabs Niles, and tosses him aside!
The tires squeal as he peels out of the driveway!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: He just stole my limo! The sheer impertinence!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That... That insufferable ape!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No one walks away from Tom Prince...

nodes.speaker: Manny
nodes.text: Twice.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I can count, Manny!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No one walks away from Tom Prince twice and gets away with it!
Wow! Looks like Colt stole Tom's limo for revenge!
But where's he going?
You'll have to find out in another episode of Surviving High School!
Thanks so much for playing!
